description: Update a DNS record in a zone.

comment.description: New comment describing the DNS record.

content.description: New content for the DNS record, such as an IP address or target hostname.

name.description: New name for the DNS record, such as a hostname within the zone.

proxied.description: Whether Cloudflare should proxy traffic through its network for this record.

record_id.description: Identifier of the DNS record to update.

ttl.description: New time to live in seconds for the DNS record, where 1 means automatic.

type.description: New DNS record type, such as A, AAAA, CNAME, or MX.

zone_id.description: Identifier of the zone containing the DNS record to update.

name: update_dns_record
